test_architecture.one_connected_suite: Create a new bounded fixture for actual prepare/apply/finish/free + actual generic pointer Debug frame/full common update/Python tails; keep retained suites as independent regression coverage. Use actual exact property metadata lookup identity, real producer and shared WM bodies from candidate source. No duplicated receipt decision logic in test model.
test_architecture.provenance: Portable selected kernel/baseline source uses exact pin/revision/blob URL where available, GPL marker and per-function hashes. CI must import/compile with ignored primary caches absent; no runtime network dependency.
test_architecture.target_reads: Maintain live-ID registry and tombstoned retained backing. Instrument getters, ID refcounts, native assign/rebuild, update/notifier/messagebus, raw setter counts and C/provider calls separately; fail-fast on stale reads for corrected source, expose old source as expected historical failure.
test_architecture.execution: C++17 Debug and NDEBUG for generic pointer/postread cases; Apple and nonApple for baseline parity; O0/O2 only for bounded provider/receipt shapes where it adds evidence. Do not multiply every matrix redundantly.
test_architecture.provider_order: New owned path must explicitly Main then validation then Scene then validation, not rely on C++ argument order. Actual old public wrapper remains a historical order/frontier control. Exact CTX getters use actual verify(nullptr) null result semantics, not an invented nullable fallback getter.
test_architecture.actual_python_scope: Extract real function-scope receipt owner, pointer conversion/report block and existing late-update position from pyrna_py_to_prop. Model interpreter conversion/refcounts/exception APIs and preserve report/DECREF order. Ordinary selected ID/None leaves value_new null: no claim of an ordinary DECREF callback. A synthetic nonnull cleanup adversary is labeled an enclosing cleanup contract test, not demonstrated user reachability.
test_architecture.native_ui: Execute actual selected-pointer set and unconditional update tail; an owned Python success must not make borrowed native UI acquire cancellation authority. Retain same C/messagebus context, not update_main substitution.
test_architecture.no_rollback: Once apply ran, a finish refusal may leave native assignment/callback effects in place. Assert exactly-one apply and no subsequent stale tags, not restoration or atomic history.

regression_groups.cases: Object.data owner removal/replacement, old-data removal, incoming-data removal during current callback-bearing guard; Debug and Release, report-bearing Python and reportless selected UI tail.
regression_groups.current_failure: Current Debug getter/refcount postreads and UI unconditional late tags hit retained tombstones; prior28 characterization provides actual source anchors.
regression_groups.required: Borrowed exact3 gates refuse before first getter/refcount/native self read/provider, perform zero Cancel and zero assign/tag. Corrected owned path is separately exercised.

regression_groups.cases: Registered owner on distinct Object/window from assigned target; target same Mesh, Edit and null-nonEmpty silent setter branches as well as different Mesh; two windows and one replacement spawned owner.
regression_groups.current_failure: Current ObjectUID filter and same/Edit skip leave owner live while full assignment/rebuild/update proceeds.
regression_groups.required: Supported owned producer drains all registered activeMain owners via fresh original context; exact setter once, then finish; callback mutation/refusal stops before next unsafe write. Distinct-object case proves policy, not dependency evaluation itself.

regression_groups.cases: Initial owner/no owner; target/value/old ID removal, UID/type/address replacement, duplicate UID, Library/override/reference/root mutation in first Main provider or first completed WM call with did=false. Numeric incoming property address replaced/mismatched before lookup.
regression_groups.current_failure: Existing Object.data wrapper has no whole-assignment receipt; current material update receipt does not span finish providers.
regression_groups.required: Original typed identities/property bound before first callback, reconstructed after every provider/WM completion even did=false. No getter used for capture, no stale metadata dereference; failure prevents later provider/Cancel/apply/tag as appropriate.

regression_groups.cases: Different Mesh and sameMesh PBVH; Empty oldImage->None/newImage/sameImage; Curve valid native type transition; Armature rebuild; material actcol0 growth, DATA/OBJECT link choices, null/same material, slot offset.
regression_groups.required: Original target UID/name/Library/override survives legitimate native changes; receipt accepts narrowly allowed poststate, retains original incoming identity, exact usercount deltas and native setter count1. Native callee field mutations outside allowed poststate fail before finish tags. Do not compare all pre/post fields for equality.

regression_groups.cases: Remove/replace target, old/incoming ID, Main, Scene, WM/window, original context membership or static property metadata after apply but before finish; during Main provider; during Scene provider. Providers may retire owner and return normally.
regression_groups.current_failure: Current material late gate can pass after provider retires owner/removes target; Object.data is unprofiled. Existing42 executes this frontier with modeled suffix.
regression_groups.required: Finish validates postsetter original receipt before provider; Main exactly once then revalidate; Scene only if Main stage still valid, exactly once then revalidate; no hidden second provider. Invalid stage yields zero later tag/messagebus and consumes/refuses receipt without reading replaced owner. Original applied mutation remains, no rollback claim.

regression_groups.cases: Initially absent supported owner target: Main or Scene provider acquires owner; same providers retire/reacquire; new owner after prepare before apply and before finish.
regression_groups.required: No native write/tag while new owner remains. Root must finalize whether stage performs a fresh all-owner drain+recapture or refuses; fixture asserts the chosen exact policy, never silently treats new owner as noowner. Borrowed initially-absent provider deletion is either protected by its own receipt or explicitly retained native-baseline boundary, not certified by early absence alone.

regression_groups.cases: Nested same/different exact3 producer from WM/provider/update callback; direct generated setter/generic update while pending; apply twice; finish twice; wrong receipt/context/profile; free before finish; two distinct sequential transactions.
regression_groups.required: Busy/one-use state prevents unauthorized nested mutation or receipt reuse, release cleanup restores next independent call, no leaked global admission. No global termination/concurrent-thread guarantee from bounded recursion tests.

regression_groups.cases: Invalidate original target/value wrapper optionals/ancestor vectors during owned cancellation/provider; BPY_context_get changes or becomes null before apply and at late update; report error; supported normal ID/None success; explicit allocation failure if API exposes it; synthetic cleanup adversary separately labeled.
regression_groups.required: Copy target/value storage before callbacks; never reread original param or ptr afterward; same saved C used through finish; BPy_reports_to_error suppresses finish after native error; every early return destroys context-free receipt exactly once without CTX/RNA/WM callbacks or pointee reads. Ordinary ID/None cleanup count remains zero nonnull DECREF.

baseline_failure_strategy.preserve: Keep current28/42 reports/logs and existing direct setter/material tests intact during design. No production patch mutation to manufacture a failure.
baseline_failure_strategy.portable: Before implementation, capture only necessary exact current196 consumer bodies/profile helper/public wrapper/Python source slices with hashes in a provenance-bearing baseline include. Reuse same instrumentation; old baseline must reach expected tombstone/noowner-policy failure or unsafe side-effect count while corrected connected candidate stops earlier. New API absence on old source alone is not behavioral failure proof.
baseline_failure_strategy.assertions: At least Object.data Debug postread case and material provider-retirement stale-suffix case must be behavioral historical failures; sameMesh/crossObject owner-live effect is a third distinct regression. Retained backing/tombstone means observed boundary, not allocator UAF.

before_implementation: Root sends final exact3 public ABI and supported owner-present/noowner NativeBaseline policy; tests reference actual implementation, not this plan as a hidden spec.
Native reviewer completes Curve/Armature/material/modifier expected poststate and exact direct-update metadata wrappers; generic update/shared helper scope is explicit.
Agree controlled allocator failure/free API test seam and whether newly acquired owners are refused or drained during finish.
Confirm native noowner/nullC/foreign input support and separate callback-free baseline from claimed owned receipt support.
verification_exit_criteria: Meaningful connected exact3 suite passes with actual native/generic/owned/Python/public-update code, historical regression behavior demonstrated, retained Object/material/ID/Mesh/WM suites pass with honest boundaries, portable CI sources present, independent native/outer/literal UI review passes; then root runs full suite/preflight and one exact native/package/compiled verification. No design report is counted as passing implementation.
limits: This is test design, no new tests executed.
Native allocator/BKE containers/depsgraph/provider/interpreter/UI/WM scheduler boundaries remain explicit per fixture.
No new device acceptance, generic all-RNA lifetime, true UAF, rollback, global CFG/reentrancy or full Curve/Armature kernel guarantee.
